title: Alcubierre Metric
description: General relativity allows a bubble of flat space to be carried faster than light - if its wall is made of negative energy. Unlocks the Warp Field Forge.

puzzle.goal: Energy and mass are one: write the energy E locked in a mass M, with the speed of light c.
puzzle.name: Mass-energy equivalence
puzzle.ask: Find E in units of 10⁴⁴ J (u = @{u}) for the mass of Jupiter, M = @{M} kg - roughly the negative energy a small warp bubble needs (c = 2.998e8 m/s).
puzzle.method: From the energy of a body at rest in special relativity: E² = (pc)² + (mc²)² with p = 0.
